note: libngspice (KiCad 10.0.6, econ-core, 2026-10-31) runs of OUR ESD decks (pcb.custom.esd_events, board.custom.esd_footholds): e0/e1 the rectifier, HBM 2 kV at 2.5 ms into /rect_out with the SMBJ5.0A (esd-3) placed there (baseline / event); e2/e3 the rectifier, IEC 61000-4-2's own current equation at 4 kV into /rect_out (esd-4); e4/e5 the UNO R3 foothold DIGITAL_L:7, the pin alone, HBM 2 kV (esd-5); e6/e7 the same with the SMBJ5.0A. Kept: every solver point within 50 us of the event, every 10th elsewhere, the last; the source network's own nodes dropped (its meters kept). Reference for esd-3 / esd-4 / esd-5.

e0.deck:
.title Polari deck (kxc-3, from the ingested rows)
.include "diode.mod"
.tran 1u 10m

C1 /rect_out GND 100n
D1 Net-_D1-A_ /rect_out 1N4148
R1 /signal_in Net-_D1-A_ 1k
R2 /rect_out GND 100k
V1 GND /signal_in SINE(0 1.5 1k 0 0 0 0)
* esd-1: hbm at 0 V into /rect_out at 0.0025 s (pcb.custom.esd_events)
Vesdchg esd_chg 0 DC 0
Resdchg esd_chg esd_k 1
Sesdchg esd_k esd_c esd_off 0 esdsw
Cesd esd_c 0 1e-10
Sesddis esd_c esd_r esd_on 0 esdsw
Resd esd_r esd_m 1500
Vesdmeas esd_m /rect_out DC 0
Vesdon esd_on 0 PULSE(0 1 0.0025 1n 1n 1 2)
Vesdoff esd_off 0 PULSE(1 0 0.0025 1n 1n 1 2)
.model esdsw sw vt=0.5 vh=0 ron=0.01 roff=1e12
* esd-3: protection part smbj5.0a (board.custom.protection_parts)
Vprotm1 /rect_out esd_p1 DC 0
Dprot1 0 esd_p1 esdp_smbj5_0a
.model esdp_smbj5_0a D(IS=1e-14 N=2.9685 RS=0.0144906 BV=7 IBV=0.01 NBV=1)
.options method=gear
.end

e4.deck:
* esd-5: hbm at 0 V on foothold DIGITAL_L:7 of datasheet/arduino-uno-r3 - the pin alone (board.custom.esd_footholds)
* the pin held at 5 V (logic_volts) through hold_ohm 1e+06; pin_cap_pf 10 (knobs on the area)
Vhold esd_hold 0 DC 5
Rhold esd_hold pin 1e+06
Cpin pin 0 10p
* esd-1: hbm at 0 V into pin at 1e-06 s (pcb.custom.esd_events)
Vesdchg esd_chg 0 DC 0
Resdchg esd_chg esd_k 1

.model esdsw sw vt=0.5 vh=0 ron=0.01 roff=1e12
.tran 10n 3.1e-05
.end
